updates.tweet_text: The cure for FOMO is recognizing the reality that no edge/setup can catch 100% of the action. If you can catch 20% of a days action on average, you are in great shape. As a Failed Breakdown trader, I only trade that slice. Some days its 5%, some days its 100%. Rest is sidelined
updates.notes: No prices mentioned at all. Tweet is philosophical commentary on trading psychology and FOMO — no actionable levels named.
